name: a byte of godBot
source:
In godBot, you are the titular machine of omnipotence. You possess the power to solve everyone’s problems— but only if you deem them worthy of solving.

Your occupation leaves no room for ambiguity. Through your eyes, everything is black or white (in both a literal and metaphorical sense). Needn’t say a word; your hands will do the talking.

[From [url=https://kittynomad.itch.io/godbot]Itch.io[/url]]
